text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I placed in the top tier.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I was so close!
Just a little more and—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Even though... I might have been able to win...
choice_data_list: Next time, let's claim first place!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not good enough...
Today made me realize that all over again...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: However... I refuse to give up.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just like everyone I look up to...
I want to... I want to, too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Next time... I will definitely take it.
1st place...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who held the Tiara
was always shining so brightly.
Not just when they won, but even when they lost...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, the brightest moment was definitely
when I stood in the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Next time, I will definitely win...!
